profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Articulate

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed TRLA's website and web based applications. Configured and maintained web application servers in Windows and Linux environments. Assisted in general tech support for staff and user management for network systems.

positions.title: Microcomputer Application Specialist / Library Assistant I
positions.description: Developed, designed and maintain the Library's Intranet system. Created web applications for faculty and students. Configured and maintained the Library's third party web based systems, both open source and proprietary. I was also selected to be a charter member of the Improving University Effectiveness Committee.
